fedavg.implementation: Sample-count weighted control, not a defense

rlr.implementation: Unweighted coordinate sign votes; sample-weighted updates; signed server LR

flame.implementation: Paper-based implementation, NOT author code; local-model cosine HDBSCAN, all-client median update norm, uniform clipped mean, Gaussian noise

lockdown.implementation: Reuse project sparse Agent; pruning/regrowth, weighted aggregation and pre-local-training-mask consensus evaluation; BadNet/DBA only

crfl.implementation: Paper Algorithm 1 global-parameter clipping/noise, final-round no noise; Monte Carlo vote smoothing. CIFAR clip/noise must be explicit; no certified radius

prodigal.implementation: Per-layer final minibatch gradient Top-K; strict votes > theta; uniform full local model mean on common support; retained local outliers redistributed to their own clients

apr_fl.reason: Only metadata/abstract verified. Need full APR selection rule, clean-data protocol, multi-task loss, optimizer schedule and authoritative implementation. No placeholder defense is run.

fedtof.reason: Publisher abstract verified; no complete algorithm/author code obtained. Need ATSD/FOF equations, history window, tail-rank/threshold rules and forgetting schedule. No generic SVD substitute is run.
